tagline: 禄来胶片相机，1939 年发布
description: 禄来于1939年推出的胶片相机。配备Carl Zeiss Tessar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm. or : Carl Zeiss Oberkochen Opton Tessar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm. or : Schneider-Kreuznach Xenar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm. filter: Bayonet size 1; Aperture: f/3.5 - f/16。快门速度Compur - Rapid; speeds: 1 - 1/500 + T & B。使用120 roll (B2), picture size 6x6cm The camera could be used with Rolleikin I to use 35mm film or with the special glass plate film adapter。on matte glass screen, via a big knob on the left side of the camera, w/ DOF scale; Focus range: 0.85-20m +inf。

specs.胶片/画幅: 120 roll (B2), picture size 6x6cm The camera could be used with Rolleikin I to use 35mm film or with the special glass plate film adapter
specs.镜头: Carl Zeiss Tessar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm. or : Carl Zeiss Oberkochen Opton Tessar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm. or : Schneider-Kreuznach Xenar 1:3.5 f=7.5cm. filter: Bayonet size 1; Aperture: f/3.5 - f/16
specs.对焦: on matte glass screen, via a big knob on the left side of the camera, w/ DOF scale; Focus range: 0.85-20m +inf
specs.闪光灯: on the left lower corner of the camera, w /M-X lever; Flash sync at all speeds
specs.英文简介: Rolleiflex Automat Model 3 is a TLR film camera and manufactured by Franke & Heidecke, Braunschweig, Germany.Engravings beneath the Rolleiflex logo: D.R.P.
